svg.title: Entity Relationship Diagram — DBCAS (11/11)
svg.desc: Bảng quan hệ: mọi khóa ngoại với hướng, cột và cardinality
svg.text: PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · NULL = nullable · legacy/retired tables are shaded amber.

g.text: Foreign keys (70) — source → destination, cardinality, ON DELETE/UPDATE
rubric_question_id_fkey: rubric(question_id) → question(question_id) [1:0..N] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES question(question_id)

g.text: selection_log_question_id_fkey: selection_log(question_id) → question(question_id) [1:0..N] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES question(question_id)

g.text: selection_log_session_id_fkey: selection_log(session_id) → assessment_session(session_id) [1:0..1] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES assessment_session(session_id)

g.text: session_question_plan_question_id_fkey: session_question_plan(question_id) → question(question_id) [1:0..1] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES question(question_id)

g.text: session_question_plan_session_id_fkey: session_question_plan(session_id) → assessment_session(session_id) [1:0..1] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES assessment_session(session_id)

g.text: session_start_request_session_id_learner_id_fkey: session_start_request(session_id,learner_id) → assessment_session(session_id,learner_id) [1:0..N] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (session_id, learner_id) REFERENCES assessment_session(session_id, learner_id)

g.text: sql_test_dataset_question_id_fkey: sql_test_dataset(question_id) → question(question_id) [1:0..N] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION

g.text: system_setting_updated_by_fkey: system_setting(updated_by) → account(account_id) [0..1:0..N] ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION/NO ACTION
g.title: FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES account(account_id)

g.text: tab_leave_interval_session_id_fkey: tab_leave_interval(session_id) → assessment_session(session_id) [1:0..N] ON DELETE/UPDATE CASCADE/NO ACTION
